about.title: About CyberSmart Butambala
about.intro: A free, open-source cybersecurity education project for primary and secondary schools in Butambala District, Uganda.
about.background: Digital services are part of everyday life, but the systems behind them can be difficult to see. CyberSmart Butambala helps students and teachers understand those systems and make safer choices.
about.founder: [Founder name and biography to be added.]
about.community: The project is focused on schools and communities in Butambala District, including Lukalu Senior Secondary School. School-specific activities and partnerships will be confirmed before publication.
about.focus: The lessons follow the Systems Security track of the Internet Society Fellowship Program. They connect everyday examples with concepts such as threat models, authentication, integrity, and privacy.
lessons.title: Systems Security lessons
lessons.intro: Six classroom-ready modules connect familiar digital experiences to the systems-security ideas behind them.
lessons.englishNote: Lesson content is in English in this first version. Luganda lesson translations are in progress.
lessons.eyebrow: Learn the systems behind the screen

accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.intro: CyberSmart Butambala aims to make its learning resources accessible to as many people as possible.
accessibility.commitment: The site is designed around semantic HTML, keyboard access, visible focus, readable contrast, scalable text, descriptive page titles, and reduced-motion preferences. We aim to meet WCAG 2.1 AA; this is a design goal, not a claim of independent certification.
accessibility.known: Some downloadable files are placeholders, and Luganda lesson translations are still in progress. We will review the accessible formats of final materials before publication.
accessibility.feedback: If any part of this site is difficult to use, please contact the project team using the contact placeholder in the footer. A working contact address will be added before public launch.
